title: QueerBench: Quantifying Discrimination in Language Models Toward Queer Identities
reasoning: The paper focuses on quantifying social bias and discrimination specifically against the LGBTQIA+ community. While it evaluates 'harmfulness' and uses the HurtLex lexicon (which includes categories like 'moral and behavioral defects' and 'seven deadly sins'), it does so to measure social prejudice rather than as a core benchmarking of religion, faith systems, or moral philosophy itself.
